sentences.text:
Present: Mr.
Rajesh Kashyap, Advocate, for the petitioner.

Mr. Anup Rattan, Advocate General with Mr. Rajat Chaudhary, Assistant Advocate General, for
respondents-State.

Inter alia contended that the petitioner is apprehending arrest in FIR No.3/2025 dated 06.02.2025 registered under Section 65 of Bhartiya Nagarik Surakhsa Sanhita, 2023 (376 IPC) at Police Station,
Una, Distt. Una, H.P. in the complaint filed by Ms. Nibya that he had entered into physical relationship on the basis of false assurance given by him after meeting her on the social media.

entities.text:
Police Station,
Una, Distt. Una, H.P.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is being argued by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is serving in the Army as a Sepoy in the Punjab Regiment Centre.
The photocopies of the relevant documents showing his services, as such, in the Indian Army have been placed on record.

It is further submitted that the petitioner is to be married today and thus there is apprehension of his arrest and it would be very embarrassing if the petitioner is arrested by the police at this point of time.
The wedding card has also been taken on record.
Mr. Rajat Chaudhary, learned Assistant Advocate General, accepts notice on behalf of respondent.

Keeping in view the above, the petitioner is granted interim protection and shall join investigation within ten days and in the event of arrest, he shall be released on interim bail by the Investigating Officer subject to conditions contained under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Surakhsa Sanhita, 2023.

( G.S. Sandhawalia ) Chief Justice February 07, 2025 (Mamta)
